title: Best Squarespace Designers (2026): How to Hire One
description: How to hire a Squarespace expert: what the package should include, how to brief your site, what drives the price and the red flags.
intro: Squarespace is known for polished templates, which makes it popular with creatives, restaurants, coaches and small shops. An expert can adapt a template to your brand, set up commerce or scheduling, and make it easy for you to update. Projects go wrong when the site is built on the expert's account, custom code is added that you cannot maintain, or the template is forced into a layout it was not built for. This guide helps you avoid that.

faq.q: Should the site be on my Squarespace account?
faq.a: Yes. Start the site on your account and add the expert as a contributor with the right permissions, or transfer ownership before final payment.

faq.q: Can Squarespace handle my store or bookings?
faq.a: It includes commerce and scheduling features, with limits depending on the plan. Ask the expert whether your needs fit Squarespace or whether another platform is better.

faq.q: What is custom code on Squarespace?
faq.a: Experts sometimes add CSS or code snippets to go beyond the template. A little is fine; a lot can break when Squarespace updates, and future editors may not understand it. Ask for a list of any code added.
Most templates can be changed a lot, but starting with one close to what you want saves time and money.

faq.q: Will I be able to update it myself?
faq.a: Usually yes. Ask for a short walkthrough on editing pages, blog posts and products.
